provenance_note: Official response of the National Diet Library's Diet minutes API (JSON, UTF-8), served with Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store; the JSON carries no timestamp, session token or request echo, so it is not generated per request. Researcher (part C): Re-downloaded from the API, the third time with a cache-busting query parameter cb=<epoch> appended; the JSON carries no timestamp, session token or request echo and is served with Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store: 4 downloads at 2026-09-24T21:44:42Z, 2026-09-24T22:13:23Z, 2026-09-24T22:33:06Z, 2026-09-25T00:06:11Z UTC (first and last 141 minutes apart) gave the same byte count and SHA-256. The part C check downloaded it again on 25 September 2026 at 00:09Z-00:14Z (plain), at 00:10Z-00:11Z (the live hosts with a cache-busting query) and at 00:40Z-00:46Z (plain), each time with the same byte count and SHA-256. Downloaded on 25 September 2026 (UTC) by this packet at 01:35:29Z, 01:42:17Z (cache-busting query), 02:16:50Z, each time with the same byte count and SHA-256; at least two downloads were 30 minutes or more apart. Bytes and SHA-256 are of the identity-encoded body, requested without Accept-Encoding (the Diet API and the Internet Archive send gzip when a client asks for it, which changes the transferred bytes but not the content). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Factual observations paraphrased with attribution; short quotations only. No photographs, emblems, seals, signatures, scanned pages or long speech text copied. No open license, portrait permission or likeness approval is asserted.
scope_note: The Diet minutes API's JSON for the whole meeting record of the 衆議院 本会議 第1号 (2026-02-18), a transcription of the House's printed minutes; the exact API URL whose bytes were hashed is recorded, and the readable minutes page is https://kokkai.ndl.go.jp/txt/122105254X00120260218. rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: After electing its Speaker (森英介) and Vice-Speaker, the House of Representatives designated 高市早苗 as Prime Minister on 18 February 2026: 354 of 464 votes (majority 233), with 小川淳也 50, 玉木雄一郎 28, 神谷宗幣 15, 安野貴博 11, 田村智子 4, 河村たかし 1 and 奥田ふみよ 1; declared under House rule 18(2).

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-13 only (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-12). Each House's designation vote, any joint committee and the House of Representatives' prevailing resolution, the Imperial appointment ceremony, Kantei statements and accounts, the Official Gazette's appointment and loss-of-office notices, the Cabinet's minutes, a cabinet's formation, its resignation en masse, any continued performance of duties and acting designations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this role: an unnamed statement or schedule row, a House of Councillors designee who never held the office, or a designation of acting ministers. Ministers, deputy prime ministers and party offices are excluded.
